title: Do it so that … (verb + hâi + result)
notes: Verb + hâi + state = do something until/so that it's in that state: àap náam mǎa hâi sa'àat.
Often used for instructions and advice: tam ngaan hâi sèt gɔ̀ɔn 4 moong yen ná.
Compare lesson 3: verb + hâi + PERSON (for someone) vs verb + hâi + STATE (result).
sentences: àap náam mǎa [hâi] sa'àat
อาบน้ำหมาให้สะอาด
Bathe the dog until it's clean.
tam ngaan hâi [sèt] gɔ̀ɔn 4 moong yen ná
ทำงานให้เสร็จก่อน 4 โมงเย็นนะ
Get the work done before 4 p.m., OK?
rian paasǎa tai hâi pûut [gèng]
เรียนภาษาไทยให้พูดเก่ง
Study Thai so you can speak it well.
tam kwaam sa'àat hɔ̂ng hâi [sa'àat]
ทำความสะอาดห้องให้สะอาด
Clean the room properly.
gin kâao hâi [ìm]
กินข้าวให้อิ่ม
Eat until you're full.
nɔɔn hâi [pɔɔ] ná
นอนให้พอนะ
Get enough sleep, OK?
pûut hâi [dang-dang] nɔ̀i kâ
พูดให้ดังๆหน่อยค่ะ
Please speak a bit louder.
kǐan hâi [sǔai] ná
เขียนให้สวยนะ
Write neatly, OK?
tam gaanbâan hâi sèt [gɔ̀ɔn] nɔɔn
ทำการบ้านให้เสร็จก่อนนอน
Finish your homework before bed.
kruu pûut cháa-cháa [hâi] nákrian kâojai
ครูพูดช้าๆให้นักเรียนเข้าใจ
The teacher speaks slowly so the students understand.

qa.ctx: 🐶 Your dog is dirty. Tell someone what to do.
😴 Your friend is always tired. Give advice.
👔 You're the boss: the work must be done before 4 p.m.
qa.a: tam ngaan hâi sèt gɔ̀ɔn 4 moong yen ná
